# xyops_server (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# xyops_server adopts a server xyOps already knows about; it never creates one.
# The agent has to register the server before this resource can adopt it.
resource "xyops_server" "local" {
  id      = "local"
  enabled = true
  notes   = "Managed by Terraform (adopted)"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `notes` (String)

### Read-Only

- `auto_group` (Boolean)
- `created` (Number)
- `groups` (List of String)
- `hostname` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip` (String)
- `modified` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xyops_server.local local
```
